tools.name: get_latest
tools.description: Latest published stories, newest first, with status labels and sources (primary first).

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: One story with its full body (why it matters, what happened, our read, pushback), sources, label history and corrections.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Full-text search over published headlines and ledes.

tools.name: get_model_tracker
tools.description: Model Tracker rows: category, release date, lab, modalities, context window, prices per 1M text tokens, license, availability, benchmarks labelled by who ran them, per-field sources with as-of dates. Preview and dated snapshot variants are folded into one row.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One Model Tracker row plus its applied changelog.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Side-by-side Model Tracker rows for 2 to 6 model slugs.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: One Model Tracker model's applied changes since 2026-10-05 (input, output and cached input price per 1M text tokens by default, or one field), each with its source URL and time, plus the price step series. Prices are decimal strings as stored.

tools.name: price_changes_since
tools.description: Applied Model Tracker price changes (input, output, cached input per 1M text tokens) since an ISO 8601 time, newest first, each with model, previous and new value as stored, source URL and time. History starts 2026-10-05.

tools.name: get_the_number
tools.description: The latest 'The Number' figure with its source, plus the previous nine.

tools.name: get_corrections
tools.description: Published corrections and retractions, newest first, optionally since an ISO 8601 time.

tools.name: what_changed
tools.description: Stories published, updated, relabelled, corrected or retracted since an ISO 8601 time (at most 7 days back), in pages of up to 500 events. If hasMore is true, call again with the same since and cursor=nextCursor. Poll this instead of re-reading the whole feed.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: Model releases dated at or after an ISO 8601 time, newest first: model, lab, kind (new, version, preview, ga, open_weights), status (confirmed: a primary source from the lab's own channel; reported: none yet), the lab's announcement time, the release date the lab's model page states, when and where

tools.name: check_model_ids
tools.description: For each model id (as written in code): the Model Tracker row, its lifecycle status, retirement date and precision, replacement, source page and when it was last checked. Match order: exact API id, API id in another case, tracker slug, display name; `match` says which. Ids the tracker does not hold

tools.name: list_retirements
tools.description: Models with a retirement date on or before `before` (YYYY-MM-DD), soonest first, optionally for one lab: status, API id, date and precision, replacement, source. Tentative (not-before) dates are left out unless include_tentative is true.

tools.name: resolve_model
tools.description: A model name or API id to Model Tracker rows. Tiers, first that matches: API id, slug, display name, entity alias, then a substring of a name or API id (3+ characters). `match` names the tier.
